title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned candidate 6 of 7 — Le plan de montage. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Le plan de montage
options.lineage: the engineering parts drawing — ruled sheet, title block, balloons on leader lines, section hatching
options.thesis: The computation is drawn as an assembly: every mark is a convention and none is decoration.
options.viewport: A ruled sheet: the rule's name and the model author's notes top-left, the computation sectioned down the field, the answer in the title block bottom-right beside its unit and the context it was resolved in.
options.risk: Can read as technical — the reader is a spreadsheet user, not a drafter, and collapses into a developer tool if the drafting conventions are shown rather than used.

raised.raise: An unopened reference must be readable from the side, end-label first, so the collapsed state still informs.
One deliberate mark where the applied branch is — never a frame drawn around every element.
Order comes from a module every part snaps to, never from ornament.

options.label: Le bulletin de paie
options.lineage: the French payslip and the accountant's columnar pad
options.thesis: The one computation document every working adult in France already reads and already trusts with money.
options.viewport: A ruled header box carrying the rule's name and its question, then the computation as lines in labelled columns — base, rate, amount — with the reader's own supplied figures set apart in the first column and the result on a heavy rule at the foot.
options.risk: Familiar to the point of invisibility, which is exactly where most runs in this category land.

options.label: The Daylight Section
options.thesis: One continuous section through the whole computation, with the applied branch as the travelling band.
options.viewport: The computation laid as a single long vertical section; the applied path drawn as a warm band that travels down through it, untaken branches left standing in a cold withdrawn grey.
options.case: Fuses cleanly: one section through nested levels is exactly what six-deep nesting needs, and a moving active band marks the applied branch without colouring anything. Loses on audience — the reader does not inhabit this world.
options.risk: The sun-and-glare apparatus is costume the moment it is taken literally.

options.label: The Select Rail
options.lineage: a film cutting bench, flattened into a sheet
options.thesis: State is a mark, not a hue — and nothing set aside is ever deleted.
materials: flag orange at a third of the screen
options.viewport: A perforated rail crossing the sheet at a fixed height; the computation strung along it as frames, the applied branch flagged with a folded tape marker, untaken branches hanging on pins in an open bin below the rail.
options.case: Fuses powerfully: a rigorous state vocabulary made of marks rather than colours, deferred branches that stay visible and reachable, and rank expressed by extent rather than type size. Loses on audience — nobody here cuts film.
options.risk: The orange commitment is unmistakable and may be more identity than a restyleable default can carry.

options.label: The Ice Press
options.lineage: a newspaper hand-set and printed on the ice through a polar winter
options.thesis: One ink, an uneven pull, and the errors left standing because there was no second chance.
options.viewport: A hand-set measure holding steady while the margins crop; the rule's provenance and its unresolved states set as standing uncorrected lines rather than hidden.
options.case: Fuses well: absence declared in the setting instead of papered over, and per-context variation made visible as uneven pressure. Loses on audience — the world is 300 miles from anyone.
options.risk: Romanticises the incomplete model, which is a defect to fix rather than a tradition to honour.

options.label: The Box Wall
options.lineage: a sneaker archive wall of stacked boxes
options.case: Fuses poorly: browsing a stack is not verifying a calculation, and a box inside a box is the incumbent's failure restated.
options.kept: The end label as the index — a stack readable from the side without opening anything.

options.label: The Marker Zine
options.lineage: hand-drawn technical zines and napkin explainers
options.case: Fuses poorly: a mascot explaining a diagram is telling rather than showing, which is the failure this product exists to refuse.
options.kept: One highlighter swipe marking the single line that matters.

options.label: The Modular Identity
options.case: Fuses poorly: the system's centre of gravity is saturated colour doing the organising, and meaning here may not ride on anything a host will replace.
options.kept: Hard bars snapping to an invisible module, so order comes from alignment rather than decoration.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: Sidebar of rule names, breadcrumb, prose paragraph, then the computation as an indented tree of labelled boxes — executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: A left rail listing rules, the rule's title and description, and under it a bordered box holding an indented tree of mechanism labels in grey small caps.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design — and it is the shape the brief already ruled out.
